name: Maiv Flower and Vegetable Farm
description: Maiv Flower and Vegetable Farm is an farm in Eau Claire, WI. Visitors come for Squash, Peppers, Asparagus, Peas, and Herbs, best in spring. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – May in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
